authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10915 lañja² explicitly gives Bengali lej/nej/nejā, Assamese lā̃z/lẽz/nez and Oriya lāñja “tail”. The selected eastern simple nouns preserve the documented nasal and nonnasal variants; longer opaque tail compounds are excluded. Any unresolved borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages is retained under the user’s preference for a provisional supported family link.
